# sertraline 
 
DrugBank ID: DB01104 
Type (MyChem.info): small-molecule 
FDA Approved (DrugCentral): December 30, 1991 
Brand Names (DrugBank): Sertraline HCl 
Route (MyChem.info): oral 
Safety (OpenFDA FAERS): NAUSEA, DRUG INEFFECTIVE, FATIGUE 
 
## Mechanisms (MyChem.info / ChEMBL) 
 
Serotonin Uptake Inhibitors 
## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
SLC6A4 
## Indications (Open Targets) 
 
Depressive disorder, Obsessive-compulsive disorder, Panic disorder, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Premenstrual dysphoric disorder, Social phobia
